text:
jamie: hey all, just joined infra squad — trying to get kubectl working. downloaded kubeconfig from the access portal but when I `kubectl get pods` I get Unauthorized. I see two contexts (redwood-dev, redwood-prod) and a dropped file from the portal. who should I ping for namespace access?

devon: welcome! pinging here. you likely need a rolebinding in the infra namespace. did you merge the portal kubeconfig or use it directly?

jamie: I merged it into ~/.kube/config so I didn't overwrite prod, just appended. could that break the auth?

samantha: merging is usually fine but context/user names can collide. the portal kubeconfig uses a user like `jamie@redwood` and a distinct context `redwood-dev-jamie`. try: `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev-jamie` then `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n infra`

jamie: tried that. `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n infra` -> "no"

devex-bot: Tip: onboarding doc is at https://docs.internal/redwood/onboarding/k8s — has the access request template and safe kubeconfig workflows :slightly_smiling_face:

devon: @sre-oncall can you take a look? jamie posted an access request in the portal but we can fast-track if we know the exact user string and namespace. suggested request body: "namespace: infra, verbs: get,list,watch on pods; reason: onboarding + debugging infra-1234"

sre-oncall: on it. for speed we usually grant `read-only-dev` clusterrolebinding scoped to the namespace for 7 days. jamie — can you paste the output of `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.users[0].name}'` (just the name)?

jamie: output: jamie@redwood

sre-oncall: thanks. i created a temporary rolebinding in `infra` for user `jamie@redwood`. can you retry: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n infra` and then `kubectl get pods -n infra`

jamie: works now, can see pods 👍 nice and fast. thanks!

samantha: re: avoiding prod mishaps — we recommend `kubectx` + `kubens` and keeping per-cluster kubeconfigs under `~/.kube/contexts/` and exporting `KUBECONFIG` like: `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/contexts/dev:~/.kube/config` before merging/viewing. we also have `scripts/merge-kubeconfigs.sh` in the onboarding repo if you want a safe merge flow.

jamie: that's perfect. also, is there a convo or doc about temporary access expiration reminders? i don't want to be accidentally locked out mid-debug.

devon: rolebindings include expiry notes and we send a reminder 24h before expiry via `onboarding-bot`. if you need an extension, file a request on the portal and mention the ticket.

jamie: great — closing this thread. really appreciate the quick help :sparkles:
